name: amazon-clean-dp-url
description: Amazonの商品ページからクリーンな /dp/ URLをコピーするFirefox拡張機能

scripts.format: prettier --write "src/**/*.{ts,json}" "scripts/**/*.ts" "tests/**/*.ts" package.json tsconfig.json amo-metadata.json README.md AMO-SOURCE-README.md CHANGELOG.md how-to-update.md
scripts.format:check: prettier --check "src/**/*.{ts,json}" "scripts/**/*.ts" "tests/**/*.ts" package.json tsconfig.json amo-metadata.json README.md AMO-SOURCE-README.md CHANGELOG.md how-to-update.md
scripts.lint: bun run build:extension && web-ext lint --source-dir dist
scripts.test:all: bun run test && bun run test:e2e
scripts.build:amo: bun run test && bun run build:extension && web-ext lint --source-dir dist && web-ext build --source-dir dist --artifacts-dir web-ext-artifacts --overwrite-dest && bun run build:source
scripts.submit:amo: bun run test && bun run build:extension && web-ext lint --source-dir dist && bun run build:source && web-ext sign --source-dir dist --artifacts-dir web-ext-artifacts --channel listed --amo-metadata amo-metadata.json --upload-source-code web-ext-artifacts/amazon-clean-dp-url-source.tar.gz
